question: Which year census is the 15th National census survey conducted by the Census Organisation of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2011.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **2011 census** is the 15th National census survey conducted by the **Census Organisation of India.**
 
• The Census of India is conducted every 10 years.
 
• Census 2011 was the 15th National census survey conducted by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India.
 
• Mr. C. Chandramouli is the Commissioner & Registrar General of the Indian 2011 Census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 About 2011 census:

 
• It was the 15th term that was conducted by the Ministry of Home Affairs regarding census in India.
 
• The census of India was conducted in two phases first in House listing and second phase in Population counting.
 
• According to the Census reports on 31 March 2011, the Population of India has increased to 1.21 billion with a Decadal Growth of 17.70 percent of the total population. 
 
• The Adult Literacy Rate has increased to 74.04% with a Decadal Growth of 9.21%.
 
• The Motto of the census of India 2011 was 'Our Census, Our Future.
 
• The Indian Government decided in May 1949 to initiate steps for Developing a Systematic collection of Statistics Data on the size of the Population and its Growth Rate.
 
• So it established an Organisation in the Ministry of Home Affairs under the name of Registrar General and Ex-Officio Census Commissioner.
 
• Registrar General office was founded in the year 1961 under the Home ministry in India. The rank of Registrar is usually held by a Civil Servant He/ She must be holding the rank of the Joint Secretary level.
